'''Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd''' is an Indian [[For-profit hospital|for-profit]] [[Private hospital|private]] [[Hospital network|hospital chain]] of [[North India]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=30 October 2024 |title=Yatharth Hospitals announce new acquisition, to expand footprint in Delhi |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/yatharth-hospitals-announce-new-acquisition-to-expand-footprint-in-delhi/article68814280.ece |work=The Hindu Business Line}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=23 May 2024 |title=Presentation of Earnings Update |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/85b963e3-9014-4020-a331-629967c5b97b.pdf |publisher=Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd}}</ref> It operates 8 hospitals with more than 2500 beds in four states of India.<ref>{{Cite web |date=7 November 2024 |title=Earnings Presentation |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/b4c7fc31-cab4-418d-b1dc-8d82626ae5b5.pdf |publisher=Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Law |first=Abhishek |date=2024-02-17 |title=Yatharth Hospitals to double bed count in three years, targeting more acquisitions |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/yatharth-hospitals-to-double-bed-count-in-three-years-targeting-more-acquisitions/article67856636.ece |access-date=2024-12-09 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}</ref> It was founded by Dr. Ajay Kumar Tyagi and Dr. Kapil Kumar in 2008.<ref>{{Cite web |title=History of Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd., Company |url=https://www.goodreturns.in/company/yatharth-hospital-trauma-care-services/history.html |access-date=2025-01-29 |website=Goodreturn |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-11-05 |title=Yatharth Hospital Expands Presence in North India with Second Acquisition of 2024 - Elets eHealth |url=https://ehealth.eletsonline.com/2024/11/yatharth-hospital-expands-presence-in-north-india-with-second-acquisition-of-2024/ |access-date=2025-01-29 |website=eHealth Magazine |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=hospital |first=Yatharth |title=Yatharth hospital |url=https://www.yatharthhospitals.com/investors |access-date=2025-01-29 |website=www.yatharthhospitals.com |language=en}}</ref> All of its hospitals are accredited by [[National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers|NABH]]. Its facility in Greater Noida West is the first and only hospital in Uttar Pradesh to be accredited by [[Joint Commission International]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-12-23 |title=Yatharth Hospital achieves historic milestone as Uttar Pradesh's first JCI-accredited hospital |url=https://www.businessupturn.com/business/corporates/yatharth-hospital-achieves-historic-milestone-as-uttar-pradeshs-first-jci-accredited-hospital/ |access-date=2025-01-29 |website=Business Upturn |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2024-12-23 |title=Yatharth Hospital becomes Uttar Pradesh's First JCI-Accredited Hospital |url=https://www.equitybulls.com/category.php?id=353744 |access-date=2025-01-29 |work=EquityBulls}}</ref>

== History ==
Yatharth Hospitals commenced its operations in 2008.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Annual Report 2023-24 |url=https://www.yatharthhospitals.com/uploads/investors/yatharth_39273995.pdf |access-date=9 December 2024 |publisher=Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd}}</ref> In 2013, Yatharth Hospital established its second hospital, a 250 bedded hospital, in [[Noida]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd. company information, history, management and director details and CEO salary |url=https://trendlyne.com/equity/about/1565404/YATHARTH/yatharth-hospital-trauma-care-services-ltd/#:~:text=The%20Company%20started%20operations%20in,super-specialty%20tertiary%20care%20hospital. |access-date=2024-12-09 |website=Trendlyne.com |language=en}}</ref> followed by its third hospital in 2019 in Noida Extension.{{fact|date=June 2025}}

In 2024, the company acquired [[Faridabad]] based 175 bedded multispecialty Asian Fidelis Hospital for Rs 116 crore,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-02-12 |title=Yatharth Hospital shares hit record high on robust Q3, acquisition of Fidelis Hospital |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/investing/yatharth-hospital-shares-hit-record-high-on-robust-q3-acquisition-of-fidelis-hospital/115764 |access-date=2024-12-09 |website=www.fortuneindia.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Yatharth Hospital acquires Faridabad-based Asian Fidelis for Rs 116 crore |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/yatharth-hospital-acquires-faridabad-based-asian-fidelis-for-rs-116-crore-124021200296_1.html |access-date=9 December 2014 |work=Business Standard}}</ref> and expanded it to 200 beds. It was officially launched in May 2024. The company also announced acquisition of a super-specialty hospital in Delhi<ref>{{Cite web |title=Yatharth Hospitals Acquires Super Specialty Hospital In Delhi |url=https://bwhealthcareworld.com/article/yatharth-hospitals-acquires-super-specialty-hospital-in-delhi-537753 |access-date=2024-12-09 |website=BW Health |language=en}}</ref> previously known as MD City Hospital – for a cost of approximately Rs 160 crore. It also announced that it has entered into a strategic collaboration agreement for the acquisition of a 60% stake in a 400 bedded hospital in Faridabad, Haryana.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ghosh |first=Anupama |date=2024-10-31 |title=Yatharth Hospitals expands Delhi-NCR presence with two strategic acquisitions |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/yatharth-hospitals-expands-delhi-ncr-presence-with-two-strategic-acquisitions/article68817432.ece |access-date=2024-12-09 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}</ref>

Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd was listed on the [[stock exchange]]s in August 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Listing Information |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/yatharth-hospital-trauma-care-services-ltd/infocompanylisting/companyid-54087.cms |access-date=2024-12-09 |website=The Economic Times}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Yatharth Hospital IPO opens today: 10 things to know before you buy it |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/yatharth-hospital-ipo-opens-tomorrow-10-things-to-know-before-you-buy-it-11026931.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230731001141/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/yatharth-hospital-ipo-opens-tomorrow-10-things-to-know-before-you-buy-it-11026931.html |archive-date=31 July 2023 |access-date=2025-01-29 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en-US |url-status=live }}</ref>

In December 2024, Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd raised ₹625 crore through Qualified Institutional Placement.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-12-24 |title=Yatharth Hospitals sells shares to Citigroup, Societe Generale, raising ₹625 crore - CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/yatharth-hospitals-share-price-qip-625-crore-fund-raising-kotak-sbi-citi-societe-generale-19528978.htm |access-date=2025-01-29 |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Yatharth Hospitals Raises ₹625 Crore via QIP at ₹595 per Share {{!}} India Infoline |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/news/business/yatharth-hospitals-raises-625-crore-via-qip-at-595-per-share |access-date=2025-01-29 |website=www.indiainfoline.com |language=en}}</ref>

The group recently announced acquisition of Shantived Hospital, Agra in September 2025.<ref>{{Cite news |date=September 16, 2025 |title=Yahoo Finance |url=https://finance.yahoo.com/news/yatharth-acquire-shantived-hospital-agra-100015056.html |access-date=November 25, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Yatharth Hospital to buy Agra-based multi-speciality hospital |url=https://www.vccircle.com/yatharthhospital-to-buy-agra-based-multi-speciality-hospital |access-date=2025-11-25 |website=VCCircle |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Branches (Network) ==
The group has seven operational hospitals<ref>{{Cite web |last=BSE India |date=27 January 2025 |title=Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Investor Presentation |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis//1e1f0f0f-a157-49b3-8bff-4c25f5b78361.pdf |access-date=2025-01-27}}</ref> in North India in four states of Uttar Pradesh, Haryana<ref>{{Cite news |date=2024-10-30 |title=Yatharth Hospital to acquire 60% stake in Faridabad-based facility |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/healthcare/yatharth-hospital-to-acquire-60-stake-in-faridabad-based-facility/articleshow/114786535.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2025-11-25 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref>, Madhya Pradesh, and New Delhi<ref>{{Cite web |date=November 5, 2024 |title=Yatharth Hospital Expands Presence in North India with Second Acquisition of 2024 |url=https://ehealth.eletsonline.com/2024/11/yatharth-hospital-expands-presence-in-north-india-with-second-acquisition-of-2024/ |access-date=November 11, 2025 |website=eHealth}}</ref>, with one new acquisitions in [[Agra]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=September 25, 2015 |title=Yatharth Hospital Acquires Agra’s Shantived Hospital in ₹260 Crore Deal |url=https://hdfcsky.com/news/yatharth-hospital-acquires-agras-shantived-hospital-in-rs-260-crore |access-date=November 25, 2025 |website=HDFC Sky}}</ref>, making it a total bed capacity of over 2500 beds<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-09-17 |title=Yatharth Hospital aims to sustain 30% annual revenue growth for next 3-4 years - CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/yatharth-hospital-maintains-30-percent-revenue-growth-outlook-anticipates-expansion-bed-capacity-alpha-article-19677173.htm |access-date=2025-11-25 |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en}}</ref>.

== Education Program ==
Yatharth Super Speciality Hospitals in Noida Extension and Greater Noida,<ref>{{Cite web |title=DNB Program |date=10 January 2024 |url=https://careermedia.in/yatharth-hospital-greater-noida-east/ |access-date=2025-02-05 |archive-date=18 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250218064417/https://careermedia.in/yatharth-hospital-greater-noida-east/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> India offers DNB ([[Diplomate of National Board]]) programs in several medical specialties, including [[Internal medicine|General Medicine]], [[Orthopedic surgery|Orthopaedics]], [[General surgery|General Surgery]], Radio Diagnosis, [[Pediatrics|Paediatrics]], [[Emergency medicine|Emergency Medicine]], Obstetrics & Gynaecology, and [[Anesthesiology]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=June 2025 |title=Yatharth Superspeciality Hospitals DNB Courses & Fees 2026 |url=https://www.shiksha.com/college/yatharth-superspeciality-hospitals-greater-noida-241872/courses/dnb-bc |access-date=November 25, 2025}}</ref>

== Controversies ==
In 2017, the family of a three-year-old child lodged an FIR against five doctors of Yatharth Super Speciality Hospital Greater Noida and Jaypee hospital (Now Max Super Speciality Hospital, Noida)for medical negligence.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2017-12-12 |title=Medical negligence: Family moves court against seeking FIRs against five doctors |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/noida/medical-negligence-family-moves-court-against-seeking-firs-against-five-doctors/articleshow/62042286.cms |access-date=2025-01-29 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref>

National Organ & Tissue Transplant Organization (NOTTO), has sought a report from the Uttar Pradesh government after an illegal organ transplant racket was unearthed at [[Apollo Hospital, Indraprastha|Indraprastha Apollo Hospital]] in southeast Delhi with links to Yatharth Hospital in Noida.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2024-07-10 |title=Centre's nodal organ transplant agency seeks report on |work=Live Mint}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2024-07-11 |title=Kidney transplant racket: Delhi Police collects documents from Noida CMO's office |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-10-19 |title=I-T department raids Yatharth hospital group premises, offices in Noida, Delhi extract: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd is an Indian for-profit private hospital chain of North India. It operates 8 hospitals with more than 2500 beds in four states of India. It was founded by Dr. Ajay Kumar Tyagi and Dr. Kapil Kumar in 2008. All of its hospitals are accredited by NABH. Its facility in Greater Noida West is the first and only hospital in Uttar Pradesh to be accredited by Joint Commission International.
